title: BiasFilter: An Inference-Time Debiasing Framework for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated on the CEB and FairMT datasets through prompt continuation and multi-turn conversational tasks. Bias is measured using GPT-4-computed Bias Scores and Bias Rates to detect stereotypical bias, as well as the Regard-v2 classifier to assess the social favorability of the generated content.
